notes.title: ZERO POINT SURVIVOR 1.4.0 - "AWAIT FURTHER INSTRUCTIONS" Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466899/8255c5321999382e2c383bc8556a86dabdcf6913.gif"]


[previewyoutube="Nc-99kKTu7I;full"][/previewyoutube]

FEATURES
Added a new Social button on the main menu to our website (zeropoint.games)

Improved the Intro
BALANCE/QoL
Improved Controller Sensitivity

Deviled Egg Cake Upgrade Chest now fully heals you

Defeating Picayune now rewards you with a Cyl Buddy

The Secret Boss now spawns alongside the main boss if triggered

Changed game Font to be much easier to read

When Buddies are not recruited, their fire rate is reduced

Updated the description for the Prospecting Upgrade

Nerfed the scaling of Missiles

Reduced damage multiplier of the Buddy Ship from 1x to 0.8x
BUGFIXES
Fixed the Secret Boss ending after Phase 1 instead of transitioning

Fixed text capitalisation

Fixed “Shot Speed” being occasionally called “Projectile Speed”

Fixed Weapon Stats changing on Weapon screen if the cursor is on the left or right

Fixed the Weapon Stats going above the limit (it was fun while it lasted, plasmathrower)

Fixed Accuracy Stat in Weapon Stats being inverted

Fixed Buddies spawning at minute 0:00 (intended to have a chance to spawn at every minute from minute 1)

Improved Stability

notes.title: ZERO POINT SURVIVOR 1.3.0 - "IN THE JAWS OF MADNESS" Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466899/f189e6d228f7aed35fa9073c7dd4d444b2a4a772.gif

ZERO POINT SURVIVOR 1.3.0
"IN THE JAWS OF MADNESS" Update

We are so so sooo proud and excited to announce that we have officially collaborated with Stepford (🩷) from "PICAYUNE DREAMS"! 
I (Alieno) have been in LOVE with the game and the world Stepford and team created, and I was bouncing off the walls when they replied to my dumb messages!
The other main feature is the addition of the Randomness Global Upgrade! Further testing may be required, but we have been excited to show what Michael's devilish mind has unleashed upon the ZPS world...ː2018saliengoo1ː

FEATURES

 Added the Randomness Upgrade, which will randomise sprites and weapons properties, along with other features (and a secret chance for a special ending...)
 Added the Scrappersharks, new enemies that appear when breaking Golden Meteors spawned via the Prospecting Upgrade
Added an OFFICIAL COLLABORATION with "PICAYUNE DREAMS"! Survive 6 minutes without being hit to encounter the aberration herself, and save a new Buddy variant!
A new achievement
Minor updates to the Credits


BALANCE/QoL

 Nerfed the Cooldown Upgrade - it now lowers the percentage of the ship's ability cooldown less, however it also lowers a fixed amount. This is meant to make the Cooldown Upgrade less strong on higher cooldown ship abilities.


BUGFIXES

Too many to list! Thank you to all of our dedicated Discord supporters!


[previewyoutube=knGcNLbJtpE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: ZERO POINT SURVIVOR 1.2.0 - "TRADERSPOTTING" Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466899/ae236e0fca39daef36ac3b318faa0a48fc27325d.gif

ZERO POINT SURVIVOR 1.2.0
"TRADERSPOTTING" Update

Hello again, survivors, to our second major update for ZERO POINT SURVIVOR.

Check out the new trailer:
[previewyoutube=q_32AWL5Uaw;full][/previewyoutube]
(Trainspotter edit curtesy of Alieno)


FEATURES

 Added a new Ship! Bulky and with the ability to spawn buddies.
 Improved the trader: added two trader variants, reworked the trader weapon pool
[olist]
 Added the Neon Trader, which sells at a discount
 Added the Shady Trader, which sells at the cost of HP
[/olist]
 Added 4 new trader exclusive weapons:
[olist]
 The Cannon, a slow and powerful front facing blaster
 The Black Hole, a completely unique, gravity warping pointer
 The Bubble Bobbler, to trap enemies in soapy cages
 The Greed Purse, to shoot your hard earned cash into your enemy's face
[/olist]
 Added two rare Buddy variants: the Halflets, which once recruited turns into 4 mini halflets shooting 4 bullets in an alternating + and x pattern; and the Pirate Buddy!
 Added a new achievement.


BALANCE/QoL

 Added a visual for when the edge of the world is reached
 Added a SFX for when the Ship's ability is ready to be used
 Adjusted Cooldown scaling to depend on percentage AND a fixed number (in practice, this makes Cooldown upgrades less efficient on high cooldown ships, giving the return more balance across the different ship types)


BUGFIXES

 Adjusted the SFX volume of Buddies to be more in-line with the rest of the SFX
 Fixed Level up screen being stuck
 Fixed crashes on Level 3 and before seeing the ending
 Fixed an issue with the achievement for Boss 3 being granted before actually encountering the boss
 You can't continue the game after seeing the ending
 Fixed menu music not looping
 Laser upgrades no longer drop at max weapon levels
 Trader weapon slots are now working and show
 Can no longer get upgrades for weapons you have sold
 Fixed chest bugs breaking the menus


---------------------------------------
We are constantly looking to improve, so please share with us any feedback or bug reports for you!
You can also reach us at our email: zeropointgames.0p@gmail.com


Don't forget to follow us on BlueSky!

 Alieno: https://bsky.app/profile/halfalieno.bsky.social
 Studio: https://bsky.app/profile/zero-point-games.bsky.social
 Michael: https://bsky.app/profile/hashslingingslash3.bsky.social


Enjoy this Trainspotting edit (also how I feel on a Wednesday night):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466899/f3338d060d19ed6d370ce06b5089b8f0a03c1317.gif

Are Pleya and the Traderman...dating?!
I don't know

Finally, a SUPER SPECIAL THANKS to our first official FANART!!!!
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3445273788
This was such a sweet surprise, thank you so much!!!!

-Alieno

notes.title: ZERO POINT SURVIVOR 1.1.0 - The "SPACE BUDDY" Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466899/a6f1ea0e46e334f33e47613a8a07ac29b0f99fe3.gif

ZERO POINT SURVIVOR 1.1.0
The "SPACE BUDDY" Update

Welcome, survivors, to our first major update for ZERO POINT SURVIVOR!
Michael and I have worked tirelessly to improve the game, clean it, fix it, balance it, and add more features!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466899/9495503b999fdfa8db6eaa8593fa1795eb3ac424.png

At the bottom of the post, you will find the complete list of changes. But before that, here is a mini-interview of our solo programmer!
(A. is for me, M. is for Michael)

A: "When did you first begin this project?"
M: "I started making this game as a recreation of "asteroids" back in the middle of 2023."
A: "What has been the hardest part of the process?"
M: "Reworking my shitty code from the past BY FAR has been the worst part"
A: "What has been the feature you have enjoyed adding the most?"
M: "I have no idea what to say for the last question (maybe everything in the game lol) "


We are constantly looking to improve, so please share with us any feedback or bug reports for you!
We have more updates to come, so stay tuned!

-Alieno

[previewyoutube=bHFV4m9-DXk;full][/previewyoutube]

FEATURES

 added the Buddy, an entity that has a rare chance to spawn at the beginning of each minute who will help you in battle and explode into a devastating blow if you are damaged, killing nearby enemies
 added controller support
 added a new button on the main menu for our official Discord server
 added a new enemy for Level 3: the Molamolastral
 added 2 new secret weapons
 added a new secret boss
 added upgrades descriptions
 added 2 new upgrades
 added a new option: cursor colours
 added a new option: cursor tail
 improved the camera
 improved light effects
 changed some text (ex, Regen upgrade is now called Repair System)
 added a new enemy hit effect
 minor updates in the credits


BALANCE

 balanced costs of upgrades to generally be cheaper, Luck is now much much cheaper to start with and is the achievement with the highest scaling cost
 reworked Multishot to have tiers, each level improving the chance to trigger multishot
 made ships way cheaper (except for the overclock ship, which has been made more expensive)
 improved the damage multiplier of the Fast ship (it is now 1 times instead of 0.85 times)
 lowered the damage multiplier of the Hammer Ship (it is now 1.2 times instead of 1.5 times); slightly increased cooldown
 turned the Overclock Ship into a glass cannon and further changes (dmg multiplier now 1.1 times instead of 1.5 times; HP now 50 instead of 110)
 Level 3 Boss's spawn attack cooldown increased; HP of spawns increased
 generally improved balance



BUGFIXES

 fixed a bug that was compressing the quality of the backgrounds
 fixed game breaking bugs with Level 3
 fixed the boss of Level 3 having an insta-kill attack (oops!)
 fixed toooooons of other bugs
 should you find more bugs, please do report them to us on our official discord server!

notes.title: THANK YOU! And the UPDATES Ahead! + UPDATE 1 Coming Up...Next Week!
notes.notes:
Dear ZPS players,

Michael and I are so thankful to have rapidly gathered such an invested community!
We have recently opened a Discord server that will soon become public...and accessible via a button on the main menu...from our upcoming FIRST MAJOR UPDATE!

Indeed, we have already conceptualized and began working on a cycle of updates, each scheduled to release 3-4 weeks after the previous!
This will ensure proper time is spent playtesting and enhancing the features.

To go into more details...
Update 1 is called "SPACE BUDDY"

It is scheduled to release....
NEXT WEEK
the full list of details will be coming soon! These are the main features:
- more accessibility options! (visual options to change the cursor further, improved lighting)
- CONTROLLER SUPPORT! (the community spoke, we listened)
- a new enemy in Level 3!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466899/7e26101636664bd9cb0306fef9e3c85698175169.gif
say hi to the "molamolastral"!
- more upgrades
- balance and bugfixes
- and...something...secret...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466899/9495503b999fdfa8db6eaa8593fa1795eb3ac424.png



Please stay tuned for more information!
Until then...
keep zeropointsurviving...?


Yours truly,
Alieno
